item.title: A 60-year mystery ends as Colombian officials identify the remains of guerrilla priest Camilo Torres
item.description: The remains of a well-known Colombian priest who joined a guerrilla group and was killed in combat six decades ago have been identified, officials in Bogota said Monday.

item.title: Wedding of trans couple in Argentina is null, archbishop says
item.description: The wedding of a transgender couple at a church in Pompeya, Argentina, on Jan. 28 has no effect and will be annulled by decree, the local archbishop told Crux.

item.title: Cuban bishop calls for dialogue amid protracted national crisis
item.description: One of Cuba’s pastors has called for dialogue and concrete collaboration to help the people amid widespread desperation and a social crisis that recently prompted the island’s bishops to cancel a planned visit to Rome to meet the pope.

item.title: New US policy on AI threatens industry disruption, puts US at loggerheads with Holy See
item.description: What was once a universe-building element in dystopian science fiction is now reportedly driving Pentagon policy.

item.title: ‘Nostalgia, measured optimism, and a forlorn feeling’: Bp Matthew Kukah on 30 years of Ecclesia in Africa
item.description: Bp. Kukah offers a nuanced perspective on Ecclesia in Africa at 30, acknowledging the "incredible light of hope" it cast while frankly confronting the "miserably slow pace of developments" that continue to challenge the continent and its people.

item.title: New Orleans celebrates Mardi Gras, the indulgent conclusion of Carnival season
item.description: As the sun rose in New Orleans Tuesday morning, rows of parade-goers already lined the street.

item.title: Caritas Bangladesh, already active, seeks to do more
item.description: “Caritas Bangladesh is working for the people of the country," Archbishop Bejoy D’Cruze of Dhaka told Crux, "regardless of race or religion."

item.title: Spanish archbishop calls burqa ‘discrimination against women’ while urging respect of religious beliefs
item.description: Speaking to Crux, Archbishop Joan Planellas of Tarragona said he didn’t believe the debate itself was a good idea.

item.title: India’s SC upholds lower court ruling in religious liberty restriction case
item.description: “It is unfortunate that the Supreme Court dismissed the plea,” Archbishop Victor Henry Thakur of Raipur told Crux.

item.title: Venezuelan Church still struggles to unify its voice after US operation in Caracas
item.description: Despite having voiced a number of sociopolitical demands over the past few weeks, the Venezuelan episcopate is still struggling to find a unified voice amid the uncertainties brought about by the US intervention in the South American nation.
